brief:
A closed-door meeting of the US-led Board of Peace for Gaza descended into a shouting match between Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and Israeli representative Michael, Middle East Eye reported. The two officials traded heated remarks during the session.

Details of the disagreement were not immediately disclosed. The incident occurred as international efforts continue to address the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.

title: Turkish, Israeli officials clash at US-led Gaza peace talks
